program_overview: 36-Week Industrial Automation, Mechatronics & National Certification Preparation Program
Connect It. Program It. Automate It. Troubleshoot It. Master the System.

The 36-Week Industrial Automation Technology Program is a comprehensive career and technical education and workforce-development program designed to prepare students for entry-level employment, apprenticeships, postsecondary technical education, industry certifications, and certification-style examinations in industrial automation and advanced manufacturing.
Students progress from fundamental electrical and mechanical principles to sophisticated automated manufacturing systems incorporating:

The program integrates classroom instruction, laboratory experiences, virtual simulations, AI-powered tutoring, troubleshooting exercises, quizzes, module examinations, certification-style testing, and career preparation.
